title: Secret Realm Manifests
next_chapter_hook: As various forces quarreled over the secret realm quotas, Chen Ji caught sight of a familiar figure at the edge of the crowd—Ye Qing had silently appeared near the secret realm entrance, her expression unusual, as if waiting for something.

text.content: The heavens suddenly cracked open a golden rift, like a scroll torn apart by an invisible giant hand. Within that fissure, ten thousand rays of rosy clouds and thousand strands of auspicious light shone forth. An ancient and vast aura surged forth from the depths of the crack, sweeping across the entire Tianqing Sect. The ancient bell at the sect gate rang without wind, copper rust fell in showers, the striking sound deep and distant, echoing among the mountains.

dialogue.content: This is... the secret realm entrance?

text.content: Chen Ji stood beneath an ancient pine at the very back of the crowd, his blue servant disciple robe slightly swaying in the wind. His gaze越过层层叠叠的身影，落在那道金色裂缝之上。The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace glowed faintly hot, as if catching a familiar aura. He lowered his eyes, fingertips gently stroking the rough fabric at his sleeve cuff, his mind racing— the secret realm's opening was a full three months earlier than he had anticipated.

dialogue.content: (Above the vast heavens, countless gazes converged on that rift. Some trembled with wild joy, some calculated amid shock. The wheel of destiny turned once more, yet the pieces on the chessboard knew not they were merely manipulated existences.)

text.content: The golden rift slowly expanded, eventually forming a ten-zhang tall gate of light. Within the gate, the faint outline of a majestic palace could be seen, with glazed tiles for roofs and white jade as steps, celestial cranes circling above the clouds. This was a relic left by ancient great powers, containing opportunities sufficient to drive any cultivator mad— techniques, elixirs, divine weapons, even breakthroughs at bottlenecks,应有尽有.

text.content: Chen Jislightly后退半步，将身形完全隐入古松的阴影之中。He scanned his surroundings, noting that several Inner Disciples had already placed their hands on sword hilts, while some elders wore expressions of fanatical excitement. He lowered his eyes, a barely perceptible smile curving his lips—beneath greed, all hearts are revealed.

choices.description: Quietly activate the Tianji Record, peer into the future within three hours after the secret realm opens
choices.visible_reward: Advance prediction of secret realm quota allocation results
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption may bring unpredictable consequences

text.content: Chen Ji探入怀中，fingertips touching the yellowed fragment. The Tianji Record trembled微动，似乎在渴望释放力量。He hesitated for a moment—five points of Heavenly Fate was enough to let him avoid predicting one life-and-death crisis. But facing the secret realm's temptation, this risk seemed worth taking.

choices.description: Quietly leave the crowd, pass the news of the secret realm's opening to specific forces, stir up the situation

text.content: As Chen Ji悄悄转身，正欲离开古松之下，his peripheral vision caught a fierce gaze fixed upon him. It was Han Lie—that Xuanwu Sect disciple who considered himself a genius yet repeatedly suffered defeats at Chen Ji's hands. The elders beside Han Lie also wore wary expressions, obviously paying extra attention to any stirrings within the Tianqing Sect.

While everyone was震慑于秘境异象，a desolate yet majestic voice rang out from the depths of the Tianqing Sect: 'The opening of the secret realm is a major event for the world, and no single sect or faction can enjoy it alone.' Everyone turned to look, only to see five figures descending through the air, with the leader being Zhou Chenzhou—head of the remaining Five Elders faction. His white hair fluttered dramatically in the wind, and his pair of turbid old eyes now blazed with brilliant light, as if wanting to claim the entire secret realm for himself.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's figure flickered at the edge of the crowd, barely visible. He gazed at Zhou Chenzhou's arrogant posture, a meaningful smile curving his lips. This old thing, after all, still couldn't hold back.)

text.content: Zhou Chenzhou surveyed his surroundings, his gaze sweeping across the elders of the three major sects, finally landing on the light gate, his voice like a great bell: 'Ancient ruins should be explored jointly by cultivators of the world. But with limited quotas, our Five Elders faction is willing to take on the responsibility of overseeing allocations, ensuring every sect and faction has the opportunity to seek fortune within.' His words were magnificent in appearance, yet concealed hidden intentions—whoever oversees quota allocation controls the key to this treasure vault.

From the direction of the Xuanwu Sect came an angry snort. Han Lie strode forward prominently, the玄武patterns embroidered on his black martial attire seeming to come alive, emanating a pressuring momentum. He stared directly at Zhou Chenzhou,丝毫不掩饰眼中的contemptuous：'Oversee quota allocation? With just you几个苟延残喘的老东西？' He stepped forward one pace, the blue stone slabs beneath his feet cracking apart, 'The secret realm opened within Tianqing Sect territory—Tianqing Sect hasn't even spoken yet, what do your Five Elders remnants count as?'

choice.prompt: The Five Elders faction and Xuanwu Sect genius Han Lie confront each other publicly, Chen Ji needs to decide how to respond to this situation

choices.description: Covertly deploy minor techniques to further inflame contradictions between both sides, reap the渔翁之利

text.content: Chen Ji悄悄从袖中取出一枚符篆，fingertip spiritual energy subtly moving. That talisman transformed into a strand of green smoke barely discernible to the naked eye, silently drifting toward the elders behind Zhou Chenzhou. Upon entering their bodies, those elders' faces instantly flushed red, their gazes toward Han Lie becoming increasingly hostile. A dispute that was originally merely verbal confrontation was developing toward an uncontrollable direction.

choices.description: Maintain a bystander's stance, calmly record the attitudes and hidden cards of all factions
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to stir up trouble

text.content: Chen Ji收回符篆，重新隐入阴影之中。His gaze穿梭于人群中，recording every change in expression—Zhou Chenzhou's intimidation masking inner weakness, Han Lie's狂妄自大, and those hidden forces yet to declare their positions within the crowd. They were the true variables in this game of power.

text.content: Chen Ji轻咳一声，从古松后踱步而出。He lowered his head, his voice timorous: 'That... I heard the secret realm contains the legacy of ancient immortals, whoever gets it can become the number one in the world... is that true?' No sooner had his words fallen than bursts of laughter erupted around him. Zhou Chenzhou and Han Lie both frowned, obviously not regarding this servant disciple highly. But beneath Chen Ji's lowered eyelids, his gaze shone cold as frozen starlight—he had seen the flash of wariness and calculation in both their eyes.

Just as the atmosphere reached a crescendo of tension, another dignified voice once again rang from the depths of Tianqing Sect: 'The matter of secret realm quotas shall be discussed later. The immediate priority is confirming the stability of the secret realm entrance.' Ling Yuan descended through the air, white-haired and white-bearded, bearing an otherworldly elegance. His gaze swept between Zhou Chenzhou and Han Lie, a faint smile playing at the corners of his lips, 'Since honored guests have traveled far, perhaps you might rest inside first. Once this one investigates the secret realm's rules, we can discuss quota matters in detail.'

dialogue.content: Discuss? You Tianqing Sect wants to buy time to monopolize the opportunities?

text.content: Before Han Lie's words even finished, the secret realm's light gate suddenly shuddered. A brilliant rune emerged from within the gate, slowly arranging into a complex pattern. Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, his voice deep: 'This is... the entry rules.' He gazed intently at that rune, his voice suddenly rising, 'The secret realm opens, limited to only ten people each time, and those entering must not exceed Foundation Building stage! Those who violate the rules will be directly annihilated by the secret realm's laws!'

dialogue.content: (The Eye of Heaven observed this scene, as if watching ants fight. It trembled slightly, seemingly smiling. The rules have been set, and the pieces will advance along the trajectories it predetermined.)

text.content: At these words, the crowd erupted in an uproar. The Foundation Building cultivation ceiling meant all senior experts from various sects were excluded. The focus of quota competition shifted from sect strength to competition among the younger generation of disciples. Zhou Chenzhou's expression grew gloomy—though the Five Elders faction had many members, most were elderly Foundation Building cultivators who would likely gain no advantage inside the secret realm.

choice.prompt: The revelation of the secret realm's rules has changed the situation's trajectory, Chen Ji needs to decide his next move

choices.description: Continue hiding one's strength, observe the abilities and weaknesses of young disciples from all factions
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity for strategic positioning

text.content: Chen Ji retreated to the edge of the crowd, beginning to silently record the auras of all young disciples present. Han Lie's arrogance, Su Qingyao's composure, and those hidden figures yet to reveal themselves—every detail could become a bargaining chip in future games. He needed a complete roster.

choices.description: Slip away quietly, find Ye Qing, discuss potential cooperation within the secret realm
choices.visible_reward: Reach consensus with the Demonic Path forces in advance
choices.risk_hint: If discovered colluding with the Demonic Path, reputation ruined

text.content: Chen Ji took advantage of the chaos to leave the crowd's edge, moving along the mountain path toward the secret realm entrance's flank. Hidden in his sleeve was a transmission talisman—as long as he activated it, Ye Qing could receive the message instantly. The Demon Sect Saintess's 'Demonic Path Fog' was key to concealing the Tianji Record's aura. This time, he had to secure this ally.

text.content: Chen Ji deliberately tripped in a crowded area, knocking over a disciple's teacup beside him. Scalding tea splashed everywhere, and the furious disciple grabbed Chen Ji by the collar, ready to strike. The chaos instantly spread, drawing several unrelated disciples into the dispute. Seizing this momentum, Chen Ji slipped out of the crowd, making his way toward the secret realm entrance's flank.

Rules set, the calculations of all factions must be redone. The elders of the three major sects wore grave expressions as they hastily discussed strategies; Zhou Chenzhou of the Five Elders faction wore a gloomy face, clearly scheming something. Meanwhile, the younger generation of disciples had burning fighting spirit in their eyes—this was their battlefield.

Chen Ji passed through the crowd, arriving at the secret realm entrance's flank area. The noise here was blocked by the mountains, rendering it particularly quiet. His gaze swept the surroundings, about to retrieve the transmission talisman to contact Ye Qing—then suddenly froze.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. In the shadows深处 at the secret realm entrance, a familiar figure stood motionless—black纱遮面, graceful figure, surrounded by faint wisps of black mist. It was Ye Qing. But her aura was completely different from before, as if shrouded in an invisible gloom. Her gaze越过层层人群，直直地看向陈机所在的方向，lips slightly parting, seemingly saying something soundlessly.)

text.content: Ye Qing's eyes flickered with complex light—warning, anxiety, and an indescribable fear. Her finger pointed toward the secret realm's direction, making an extremely subtle gesture. That gesture, Chen Ji had seen in some prophecy before but never pondered deeply. Instinct told him that Ye Qing brought absolutely no good news—but rather some devastating news that could overturn the entire situation.

Ye Qing's figure flickered in the shadows and vanished, as if never having been there. Only at the spot where she had stood, a faint lingering fragrance remained in the air, along with a slip of paper somehow placed in Chen Ji's sleeve. Chen Ji slowly unfolded the paper, eight elegant small characters written upon it: Heavenly Secrets Have Eyes, Flee Quickly. He silently recited these eight characters in his heart, the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace shuddering violently, as if responding to some warning.
